title.narrative: Scale up finding of TB missing cases - Cameroon (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Cameroon, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Public Health of the Republic of Cameroon (MOH)This program has the following goals: Diminuer l'incidence de la tuberculose de 186 pour 100 000 habitants à 130 pour 100 000 à l'horizon 2024/Reduce the incidence of tuberculosis from 186 per 100,000 population to 130 per 100,000 by 2024.. Diminuer les décès dus à la tuberculose de 54 pour 100 000 à 32 pour 100 000 à l'horizon 2024/Reduce tuberculosis deaths from 54 per 100,000 to 32 per 100,000 by 2024.. The objectives of this program are: Augmenter le nombre de nouveau cas et rechutes notifiés de tuberculose (toute formes) jusqu'à atteindre 34 286 pour l'année 2023 /To increase the number of reported new cases and relapses of tuberculosis (all forms) to 34,286 by the year 2023.. Une augmentation de plus 100% de cas TBMR détectés en 2023 par rapport a 2018 (172 cas) soit 405 cas. / The number of MDR-TB cases increased in 2023 to more than 100% compared to 2018 (172 cases), with 405 cases for the year 2023.. 98% des patients tuberculeux sont testés pour le VIH et au moins 98% des coinfectés sont mis sous traitement antirétroviral d’ici 2023./98% of tuberculosis patients are tested for HIV and at least 98% of co-infected patients are put on antiretroviral treatment by 2023.. Traiter avec succès 88% de cas de TB notifiés d'ici 2023 par rapport à 83.11% en 2018/Successfully treat 88% of notified TB cases by 2023 compared to 83.11% in 2018.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for CMR-T-MOHP03
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB incidence rate per 100,000 population
TB mortality rate per 100,000 population
Outcome indicators targets and results for CMR-T-MOHP03
Notification of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases – Percentage of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed, drug resistant RR-TB and/or MDR-TB as a proportion of all estimated RR-TB and/or MDR-TB cases
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Case notification rate of all forms of TB per 100,000 population - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse cases
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for CMR-T-MOHP03
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
Percentage of health facilities with tracer medicines for the three diseases available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Number of notified TB cases (all forms) contributed by non-national TB program providers - community referrals
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy

Percentage of laboratories showing adequate performance in external quality assurance for smear microscopy among the total number of laboratories that undertake smear microscopy during the reporting period
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Percentage of registered new and relapse TB patients with documented HIV status
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Completeness of facility reporting: Percentage of expected facility monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
